protocol: TechQA v2 frozen primary evaluation preregistration
training_strategy: random proxy negatives cap50, equal total weight per query, original nine features; hyperparameters by train component CV only
pipeline_selection: head_onnx chosen before its development scores; ablations remain development robustness and cannot replace primary based on dev maxima
rrf_selection: finite prespecified development grid in primary configuration, freeze chosen constant/weight from completed primary run
query_policy: Keep historical splits, quarantine entire confirmed MQ cross-split component, do not remap old train/dev into test
limitations: Performance is measured against provided sparse/noisy archive qrels, not exhaustive relevance or generated-answer correctness
89 highest-risk cross-split pairs reviewed by Codex assistants; neither these judgments nor lower-similarity candidates are independently human/domain-expert adjudicated
SPSS Mac launch symptom group is an uncertainty sensitivity note, not a confirmed same-cause duplicate merge
Source CVE-2017-1741 versus gold CVE-2017-1731 conflicts remain source-quality warnings; no qrels corrected based on scores
Development intervals are exploratory; final primary contrast must be fixed before any held-out metric is opened
stopping_rule: After this one frozen heldout evaluation, report positive or negative result; do not retune using test outcomes
reviewer_provenance: Codex assistant review; actual members/domain experts have not independently validated the semantic judgments
